item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 31/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Upper-air disturbances will bring showers and squally thunderstorms to southern China today. With the upper-air disturbances departing and under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather will be brighter and hot with a few showers over the region in the following few days.

Date/Month: 31/03 (Sunday)
Wind: South force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers. Rather low visibility in some areas and sunny intervals in the morning. A few squally thunderstorms later.
Temp range: 24 - 30 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High

Date/Month: 01/04 (Monday)
